CLI: Pinned Python -I -S -B absolute/run_catalogue_v1.py absolute/ROOT-plan-v1.json; sole runtime argument is frozen plan path.

required_plan_fields.inputs: exact six-role raw-pin dictionary above; each role SHA/bytes hardcoded
required_plan_fields.runner: exact executing Source raw pin; path matches __file__
required_plan_fields.output_directory: ROOT-created absolute existing empty directory; exclusive xb outputs
required_plan_fields.maximum_output_bytes: positive exact integer <=536870912; JSONL plus summary complete bytes
required_plan_fields.maximum_case_bytes: positive exact integer <=maximum_output_bytes; every full JSONL record

extra_plan_metadata: Permitted and preserved in header; ROOT owns actual Source/review/runtime/native-meter/master pins and actual authorization. No supplied answers, learned clauses or proof routes.

fixed_catalogue.generation: itertools.combinations(range(8),4), lexicographic four-element subsets, no exclusions or outcome-based ordering
fixed_catalogue.mask_bits: for i in 0,1,2: (mask >> (2-i)) & 1; signed literal +1 for bit1 and -1 for bit0, literal ports always i order

discovery.fresh_model: Original four-clause point model, all original guards active, no learned gadgets or hypotheses.
discovery.proposal_rule: Only complete EXHAUSTED_FINITE_MARKED_MODEL roots propose the negation of the WHOLE singleton boundary. No partial failure, learned restriction or deleted assumption qualifies.
discovery.certification: Compute original oracle truth set once; independently certify candidate against every original satisfying assignment, with no hardcoded nonvacuity/expected learned count. The separate case verifier recomputes original semantics.
discovery.selection: First two distinct normalized non-original certified clauses in discovery order, maximum two; may select zero or one. Preserve all six outcomes and every exhausted-root proposal.
discovery.UNKNOWN: Retain raw trace/result/audit and never propose. No accepted witness or finite-exhaustion claim.

replay.boundaries: empty boundary first, then the same six singleton boundaries
replay.rotation: (catalogue_index+boundary_index)%4, rotate fixed arm tuple; never outcome/timing dependent
replay.ordinary_learned: Original clauses followed by exactly selected clauses.
replay.point_inventory: Both arms contain exactly the same entire bit/tuple/guard inventory for original+selected clauses, including all forbidden tuples. Original guards active in both; only extra guard m assignments absent versus zero differ.
replay.freshness: Each model/state/solve fresh; pinned modules loaded once for this single cohort worker.
replay.semantics: First finite satisfying assignment or complete finite exhaustion or UNKNOWN, with seed boundary. Ordinary and point work units remain separate.

independent_checks.point_per_result: Unchanged pinned raw point auditor audit_result, with allow_unknown exactly matching result status; original oracle witness/status check.
independent_checks.ordinary_per_result: Unchanged prior pinned verifier.verify_ordinary_result plus original oracle witness/status check.
independent_checks.whole_case: New pinned catalogue_verifier.verify_case(case, prior_verifier.verify_ordinary_result), exact six discovery and28 replay wires, complete original declaration/truths/learning/provenance/inventory/audits; raises on failure.
independent_checks.required_case_audit: valid_saved_case is True; all_boundaries_completed exact bool; unknown_count exact nonnegative int. Runner independently counts raw UNKNOWNs and requires exact agreement. UNKNOWN alone may remain a valid saved prefix.
independent_checks.shadow_analysis: The new verifier recomposes identical selected placement IDs under baseline and marked definitions. Baseline removes learned R marks from BOTH selected state union and tested candidates. Counts are repeated observations, not unique candidates or proof the baseline search reaches that prefix.

catalogue-results.jsonl.encoding: Canonical sort_keys JSON, compact separators, ensure_ascii, no NaN; one newline per record; complete EOF. One case C-encoded at a time, no full-suite result list/string.
catalogue-results.jsonl.case_fields: case, independent_verification, case_verification_ns plus schema; whole case verified before write.
catalogue-results.jsonl.footer: Exactly70 sequential verified case lines; observed solve counts recomputed from summary outcomes and asserted420/1960. Rolling case-line SHA/bytes exclude header/footer; preceding SHA/bytes include header+70case lines; terminal footer is not a native process-exit certificate.
catalogue-results.jsonl.partial_rule: Any exception, deadline or output cap can preserve a prefix/partial line but cannot yield accepted whole cohort. ROOT must require full footer, summary, EOF and true successful native terminal.

streaming_outputs.summary.json: Exactly70 lightweight rows; original/learned outcome counters, four timing+work rows and shadow totals. Full per-boundary shadows/traces are ONLY in JSONL case records. Complete JSONL SHA/bytes include footer; whole output byte cap includes summary.
streaming_outputs.stdout: One compact status/count/total-output-bytes line; fresh deadline/memory sampling follows stdout flush. ROOT authenticates actual terminal separately.

cost_and_retention.begin: Native begin immediately after first time import, before remaining imports/Source authentication/compile/modules/setup. External ROOT caller additionally accounts interpreter and time import startup plus finish.
cost_and_retention.deadline: Absolute40s from this original begin, never reset. Checks before/after Source load, oracle, solves/audits, whole-case verification and output; no claim of continuous preemption inside unchanged callees. External terminal40s gate mandatory.
cost_and_retention.memory: Pinned Darwin ru_maxrss bytes sampled at every deadline, cap512MiB. Full true terminal native peak/caller closure mandatory; no other child process exists. No fit measured or guaranteed by Source.
cost_and_retention.charged: All original truth computation, discovery, certification, four-arm fresh builds/searches/per-result checks, repeated independent ordinary checks in whole-case verification, shadow analysis, canonical JSON serialization, writes/flush, summary and stdout.
cost_and_retention.retention: At most one full case+audit+one bounded encoded JSONL record, small frozen modules and70 summary rows. Every written case/audit/local row is released before next iteration; rows retain only small learned records, counters/timings/shadow totals. No entire cohort array.
cost_and_retention.time_accounting: Nested case/arm/phase clocks are reported for interpretation, never added on top of enclosing native duration. Shared learning cost is counted once per learned strategy for first-use comparisons, not multiplied into actual physical cohort cost.
cost_and_retention.fairness: Cohort shares module loading, fresh per-solve state, fixed work caps, same semantic boundary and checker. Different ordinary/point counter units and padding/check costs remain explicit; one observation cannot establish reproducible speedup.

scope: Finite three-variable same-context failure-clause learning calibration and ordinary comparator. No Q qualification, RL, held-out transfer, full point-engine contract, fixed Wang universality, general theorem proof route or measured speedup.
remaining_gates: Distinct whole runner and new catalogue-verifier Source reviews.
ROOT-authored actual frozen plan, native meter/caller and explicit40s/512MiB acceptance.
Actual whole70 lines+footer/EOF+summary/native terminal and independent saved reconciliation; all2380 solves/UNKNOWNs retained.
authorship_disclosure: Runner and prior ordinary DPLL authored by arithmetic; new independent case/ordinary verifier authored by controls, engine by diagnosis. Runner author does not self-review its solver semantics; future distinct reviewer must preserve attribution.
